question: What will be the percentage change in front-month Brent crude oil futures (BZ=F on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-14 to the close on 2026-09-21?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-21 / close on 2026-08-14 - 1), using daily closes of BZ=F on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-21, the last close before it is used.
baseline:
Computed by code from Yahoo Finance daily closes for BZ=F: latest close 88.5200 on 2026-08-14.
Target date 2026-09-21 is 26 trading observations ahead. Percentiles of the price on the target date,
from the empirical distribution of 26-observation returns over the last 3 years (last year weighted double):
p5: 74.766, p10: 79.5711, p25: 83.7895, p50: 87.8753, p75: 93.8794, p90: 101.5355, p95: 109.8571

research:
I couldn't read Yahoo's BZ=F page directly: every page fetch was refused by the proxy, so all figures below come from search-result summaries. Brent rose about 5-6% in the week to the Aug 14 close and was still climbing on Aug 17. That is when the US-Iran interim deal expired, with the Strait of Hormuz still restricted.

## 1. Resolution source
- The data series is Yahoo Finance BZ=F (front-month ICE Brent). I couldn't load the history page.
- 2026-08-14: CNBC says Brent futures rose 1.7% and settled at **$88.52**. WTI settled at $82.40. Both gained more than 5% on the week. Bloomberg says Brent settled "above $88", up about 6% for the week. Yahoo's close should be about $88.5, but I haven't checked it on Yahoo. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/14/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz.html), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-13/latest-oil-market-news-and-analysis-for-aug-14)
- **Contract roll:** the front month on Aug 14 was October Brent, which expires at the end of August. Aug 31, 2026 is a UK bank holiday, so expiry may move to about Aug 28. After that, BZ=F switches to November. If the curve is in backwardation, the switch lowers the series mechanically. I found no source from before the cutoff giving the Oct-Nov spread. An April 2026 note described extreme backwardation, about $50 front to back at that time. [Parameta](https://www.parametasolutions.com/insights/extreme-brent-backwardation-managing-curve-dislocation-with-otc-oil-data/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The question covers about 25 trading days, and the end date is Monday, Sept 21.
- 2026-08-17 (intraday, before the forecast closes): CNBC reported Brent above $90, roughly +2% from the Aug 14 close. Iran ruled out extending the US-Iran memorandum signed June 17, which expired that day. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/17/oil-prices-iran-war-strait-hormuz.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/17/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz.html)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-17: President Trump said the US is not in talks with Iran and none are scheduled. According to Kpler, five commodity vessels crossed Hormuz on Saturday and none were registered for Sunday. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-17/latest-oil-market-news-and-analysis-for-aug-18), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/17/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz.html)
- 2026-08-14: Treasury Secretary Bessent said the naval blockade of Iranian ports stays in place. He promised economic pressure "like the world has never seen", with details due the following week. The war that disrupted Hormuz is in its sixth month. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/14/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz.html)
- 2026-08-14: Barclays kept its 2026 Brent forecast at $96. It expects the recent inventory build to reverse. [GBM/Reuters](https://gbm.com/media/noticia/barclays-mantiene-prevision-de-que-precio-del-petroleo-brent-se-situe-en-96-dolares-barril-en-2026/)
- 2026-08-14 (6:30 a.m. ET): Brent was at $89.53, about $22.30 higher than a year earlier. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-oil-08-14-2026/)
- 2026-08-12: Prices rose to about $90 after attacks on shipping hurt hopes of reopening the strait. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/8/12/oil-prices-rise-as-attacks-dent-hopes-for-strait-of-hormuz-reopening)
- 2026-08-11: Brent settled at $88.91 (+1.4%) after an Iranian official said Hormuz stays shut until Iran's conditions are met. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/11/oil-prices-today-us-crude-84.html)
- 2026-08-06: Prices jumped after Iran published a restrictive draft plan for the strait. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/06/oil-price-iran-war-strait-hormuz-oman-deal.html)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- 2026-08 (IEA report): renewed fighting pushed Brent as high as $105 on July 23. North Sea Dated rose $25.67 over July to $96.80, then was about $92 when the report was written. In other words, a roughly 15% fall from peak in about three weeks. [IEA](https://www.iea.org/reports/oil-market-report-august-2026)
- Recent daily moves of 1.5-2% are common: +1.7% on Aug 14 and about -2% on Aug 13. CNBC also reported a single-day jump of about 5% on tanker attacks. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/14/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz.html), [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Jumps-2-as-Iran-Steps-Up-Attacks-on-Hormuz-Tankers.html)
- My own estimate, not from a source: at 25-35% annualized volatility (calm years), the 5-week standard deviation of Brent is about 8-11%. At 45-60% (crisis conditions like now), it is about 14-19%. Headlines can still move prices in jumps that are larger than this.
- The planned roll from October to November will probably subtract a few percent if backwardation holds, but I don't know the size.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-11, EIA's August outlook: Brent averages $85.21 in Q3 2026 and $78.00 in Q4, assuming severe Hormuz constraints last through August. [S&P Global](https://www.spglobal.com/energy/en/news-research/latest-news/crude-oil/081126-us-eia-raises-brent-outlook-to-87b-on-hormuz-shipping-constraints)
- 2026-08-14: Barclays forecasts $96 for 2026 (see section 3).
- Kalshi lists daily and weekly Brent markets (KXBRENTD, KXBRENTW) that include dates near Sept 21. I couldn't see any prices for them dated on or before Aug 17. I found no Polymarket or Manifold market on this question. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxbrentd/brent-oil-daily/kxbrentd-26sep2117)

## 6. Upcoming events before Sept 21
- Week of Aug 17: the US is expected to announce new sanctions and economic measures against Iran. The interim US-Iran deal has lapsed, so there is a risk of escalation, or of new talks (possibly mediated by Oman or Qatar).
- About Aug 28: October Brent expires and BZ=F rolls to November.
- Early September: OPEC+ monthly meeting. I couldn't confirm the date.
- About Sept 9-11: the September EIA outlook, OPEC monthly report and IEA monthly report are due.
- Sept 15-16: Federal Reserve FOMC meeting.
- Throughout: daily Hormuz transit counts (Kpler), attacks on tankers, the US naval blockade, and the Atlantic hurricane season.
